assessments.reasoning: The Creative Commons host, masthead and legal-code title identify the publisher. Four contiguous ranges cover all 51,922 bytes of https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode. The page labels the instrument “CC BY 3.0” and supplies the inline license, including §3, License Grant.

The Index’s SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7, bytes [533,639), admits a license with identifiable text, edition and controlling source. The document expressly includes historical editions. This supports the kind assigned to the publisher’s instrument.

The 2026-11-26 Index decision at a375f9b476ad9ad1154a781230a08d7cab205225, bytes [1005,1206), gives permanent ID d8e007f997bb4c40b5f2fc91d8970234, CC-BY-3.0, Attribution 3.0 Unported, cc-by-3-0-unported, sha256:aa7cbb71214fb5709a70e710fbeefd8d9108a380699d393038b9ba11126f3a15, license and active. The ID matches the UUID portion of the claim subject and the revision matches the publisher capture.

challenge.method: Tested the page’s 4.0 recommendation, site footer, linked deed and alternate formats as possible sources of the title. Compared the Index row with the BY 4.0, BY-NC, BY-ND and BY-SA rows and checked for a jurisdiction designation.
challenge.results: The main heading and the heading inside legal-code-body both say “Attribution 3.0 Unported.” The 4.0 recommendation points to another edition, and the footer describes site content. The reference path has no jurisdiction segment. Each alternative Index row has a different entity and capture digest.

limitations: The HTML digest identifies the response measured at acquisition. The page declares /legalcode.en canonical. Equality of its bytes with the captured /legalcode response is unverified.
Active describes Index maintenance for documentary lookup. Publisher currency, legal effect, SPDX deprecation and release authorization are separate questions.
The finding covers the named reference only. Semantic equivalence, translations, adaptations, downstream grants, project-wide licensing and redistribution rights are outside its scope.
